item.title: December 1.0 (75)
item.description: - Moving a folder no longer leaves files behind or deletes things you didn't select. - Copying a file that already exists in the destination now asks instead of replacing it. - Cancelling a copy, an import or an archive actually stops it, and nothing half-written stays on disk. - Locked files copy again, and stay locked. - Importing can't write outside the folder you picked through a symlink. - Large uploads to cloud storage work again.
